sql: select cls, count(*) n, sum(anglers) a, sum(yt) yt from trips where fish_date_t > (select max(fish_date_t) from trips) - 14 group by cls union all select 'pier7', count(*), avg(wtmp_c*9/5+32), max(wtmp_c*9/5+32) from pier where ts_t > (select max(ts_t) from pier) - 7

summary: Cold-year fallback: commit Friday PTO at historical fall peak (doy 268-300) regardless of temp; also go in fall on solid bite >=1.2 over 3+ boat-days.
